description:
Turn your Windows PC into a console on the TV with one click.

Console Mode focuses your TV, turns off or hides the other monitors, switches audio to HDMI and launches Steam Big Picture, Playnite fullscreen or Xbox mode. When you quit Big Picture or Playnite, your desktop layout is restored automatically.
What's new
- Minimize to the system tray: with the new option in Settings (also in the Console interface, under System), minimizing the window takes Console Mode off the taskbar and leaves just its icon in the hidden icons; one click on the icon opens it again. Off by default. (#150)
- German (Deutsch) interface, translated by a community member, plus French (Français) and Russian (Русский). With Windows in one of these languages the app opens in it, and the installer offers them too. (#151)
Downloads
- Installer: ConsoleMode-Setup-x64.exe — installs the app and offers shortcuts and starting with Windows.
- Portable: ConsoleMode-Portable-x64.exe — a single executable; keeps its data in the ConsoleMode_Data folder next to the file.
🇧🇷 Notas em português: CHANGELOG.md
